articles.title: Awaiting review
articles.purpose: Understand the status of a submitted registration.
articles.steps:
Read the current registration status.
Wait for an independent reviewer; do not resubmit a pending record.
Respond to any returned correction request.
articles.requirements: Your existing authorised account and the information displayed by the application.
articles.next_step: Follow the stage shown by the application.
articles.issues: Help explains the process but does not grant permissions or change an operational decision.

articles.title: Capture household coordinates
articles.purpose: Record household coordinates with clear provenance.
articles.steps:
Capture device location only when the device is at the household.
Enter latitude and longitude together or leave both empty.
Submit the form to save coordinates. Dummy points are demonstration data, not verified homes.

articles.title: Edit guidance
articles.purpose: Prepare concise public task instructions.
articles.steps:
Enter the service, stage and audience.
Write steps, requirements, next steps and common issues.
Save the draft, then submit it for an independent review.

articles.title: Review and publication
articles.purpose: Publish guidance through independent review.
articles.steps:
An author submits a draft.
A different verifier reviews it or returns it with a reason.
An authorised supervisor publishes the reviewed version.

articles.title: Version history
articles.purpose: Inspect and restore a previous guidance revision.
articles.steps:
Open a version from the guidance history.
Review its content and recorded action.
Restore it as a new draft when needed; independent review is required before publication.
